attendance_policy: As a part of attendance linked evaluation, 2 quizzes (1 before midsem & 1 after midsem) will be held, which will account for 10% weightage. These quizzes will be considered for students with attendance  50%
makeup_policy: Make-up only in genuine emergency/unavoidable cases such as medical admission in hospital or participation in an event to represent the Institute. No make-up to attend marriages or other social functions.
